editorial_thesis: Today’s strongest practical signal sits at the edge of execution: GPU simulation makes physical AI more testable, creative agents are moving into production surfaces, local inference is becoming a real deployment option, and self-hosting is best treated as a deliberate boundary.

topic_groups.title: Robotics Simulation
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Recent coverage under-served hardware and physical AI; current release signal makes a bounded sim-to-real experiment practical.

sources.title: Newton v1.5.0 releases
sources.why_selected: Expands scalable batched simulation and robot-control workflows.
sources.usefulness: Run reproducible policy smoke tests across seeds.

sources.title: Isaac Lab releases
sources.usefulness: Compare headless training and CI friction.

sources.title: Genesis release notes
sources.why_selected: Improves differentiable rigid-body simulation and numerical robustness.
sources.usefulness: Use as a control condition for simulator selection.

topic_groups.title: Creative Agent Production
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Creative tooling is shifting from isolated generation toward orchestration, precise editing, and portable provenance—useful for client delivery systems.

sources.title: Firefly AI Assistant
sources.why_selected: Brings creative workflows into a conversational agent surface.

sources.title: Adobe Blog updates
sources.why_selected: Highlights Precision Flow and AI Markup for controlled edits.
sources.usefulness: Compare deterministic markup edits with regeneration.

sources.title: Credentio C2PA library
sources.usefulness: Add verifiable metadata to creative handoffs.

topic_groups.title: Edge AI
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Hardware and local-first deployment were under-covered; Google’s Raspberry Pi guide creates a concrete, measurable experiment.

sources.title: LiteRT + Gemma on Raspberry Pi
sources.why_selected: Provides a practical path to local inference on inexpensive hardware.
sources.usefulness: Measure latency, memory, accuracy, and offline behavior.

sources.title: Model routing with Google Cloud API Gateway
sources.why_selected: Frames escalation as a routing policy.

topic_groups.title: Self-hosted Automation
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Self-hosting has been absent from recent lanes; current tools support a practical boundary-first experiment without treating full ownership as the goal.

sources.title: n8n repository
sources.why_selected: Offers self-hostable workflow automation and agent building blocks.

sources.title: Self-hosting sweet spot
sources.usefulness: Score sensitivity, portability, burden, and recovery.

sources.title: Dify repository
sources.why_selected: Supports cloud, VPC, and self-hosted agentic workflows.
